paper: MarketSenseAI 2.0: Enhancing Stock Analysis through LLM Agents
headline_mechanism: MarketSenseAI 2.0 sends monthly News, Fundamentals, Dynamics, and Macroeconomic analyses to a Signal agent that emits Buy/Hold/Sell ratings used in long-only equal- and capitalization-weighted U.S. portfolios.

source_anchors.claim: Four specialized agents analyze news, company fundamentals, price dynamics, and macroeconomic conditions.
A fifth agent synthesizes specialist outputs into monthly Buy, Hold, or Sell ratings.
Buy-rated S&P 100 or S&P 500 constituents form equal- and capitalization-weighted long-only portfolios.
The backtest applies a 10 basis-point transaction fee to trades.

preserved_elements: four distinct news, fundamental, dynamics, and macro specialist scores
approximated_elements: earnings surprise and attention characteristics replace unavailable news text
JKP valuation, quality, and distress characteristics replace filings and transcripts
formation-time momentum and volatility characteristics replace price-analysis prompts
market return, volatility, breadth, and beta interaction replace macro RAG
past RankIC-weighted numerical consensus replaces GPT-4o signal synthesis
invented_elements: the exact JKP specialist feature bundles
common long-short decile adapter for apples-to-apples comparison
portfolio_adapter: For cross-paper comparability, the continuous signal-agent score is mapped to the frozen capitalization-weighted top/bottom deciles rather than the paper's long-only Buy subset; the common 10 bp one-way cost matches the paper setting.
claim_boundary: This is a researcher-authored MarketSenseAI-inspired numerical five-agent policy, not the unavailable GPT prompts, RAG inputs, monthly signal records, native long-only holdings, VectorBTPro run, or paper results.
